name: yayaw-table-vue-connector-notion
title: YaYaw Table Vue Notion Connector
description: Optional, framework-agnostic server module that pushes table rows into a Notion database (upsert keyed by a "Yayaw ID" property). Runs in Node 20+, Bun, Deno and edge runtimes; the host stores the token, authorizes the push and calls it from its server.
